title: Nutrition and Health Programmes in India — MDMP, ICDS, NFSM and More
shortDescription: Mid-Day Meal / PM POSHAN, ICDS/Poshan 2.0, National Food Security Mission and related schemes.
genZNote: Which scheme feeds whom? ICDS, PM POSHAN, NFSA, NFSM — four acronyms, four different audiences. Sort them and the table is yours.

sections.heading: Key Programmes
sections.body: Gujarat examples: Mukhyamantri Matrushakti Yojana and Poshan Sudha for mothers; Amul-led dairy cooperatives; PM POSHAN is implemented in Gujarat through the school meal system. Verify names and entitlements against current notifications.

table.caption: Programme snapshot
rows: School children (Balvatika, classes 1–8 in government/aided schools)
Hot cooked meal: norms of ~450 kcal/12 g protein (primary) and ~700 kcal/20 g protein (upper primary); started 1995; renamed PM POSHAN in 2021
Children 0–6 years, pregnant and lactating women, adolescent girls
Six services: supplementary nutrition, pre-school education, immunisation, health check-up, referral services, nutrition & health education; delivered via Anganwadi centres
Convergence, technology (Poshan Tracker), targets for stunting, anaemia and low birth weight
Subsidised foodgrains through TPDS; maternity benefit; PMGKAY free grain
Production-side mission to increase rice, wheat, pulses (later coarse cereals/nutri-cereals, oilseeds) — an agricultural, not feeding, scheme
6×6×6 strategy: six age groups, six interventions, six institutional mechanisms
National Iodine Deficiency Disorders Control Programme

sections.heading: Exam Notes
bullets: Two different "food security" items: the National Food Security Act (entitlement) vs the National Food Security Mission (production).
ICDS began on 2 October 1975; Mission Poshan 2.0 (2021–26) integrates Anganwadi services and Poshan Abhiyaan.
Fortified rice is being supplied through schemes (rollout by 2024).
Rashtriya Poshan Maah: September; National Nutrition Week: 1–7 September.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: India combines school feeding, early-childhood nutrition, subsidised grains, anaemia and micronutrient programmes and production-side missions to tackle hunger and malnutrition.

highYieldFacts: PM POSHAN covers Balvatika and classes 1–8.
commonTraps: Do not mix NFSA (entitlement) with NFSM (production).

confusedTerms.distinction: NFSA is a legal entitlement to subsidised grain; NFSM is an agricultural production mission.

sources.name: Ministry of Women & Child Development — Poshan 2.0
